create_meshes_batch: create a Meshes object from a list of vertex and face tensors for a batch of triangulated meshes
get_verts_packed: get the packed representation of vertices as a single tensor of shape sum(V_n) by 3
offset_mesh_vertices: offset the vertices of a Meshes object by a given tensor of offsets in place or out of place
scale_mesh_vertices: scale the vertices of a Meshes object by a scalar or per-mesh scale factor
join_meshes_as_batch: merge multiple Meshes objects into a single batched Meshes object with optional texture joining
